_doc: Ambient insect surfaces (docs/kb/art/wildlife.md, M3-CRE-616); write_materials.py writes assets/wildlife/insect/materials/<slot>.tres on game/world/wildlife/wildlife.gdshader. moth: matte and dusty (a fine, high detail noise for the fur and wing scales). dragonfly: the wetness channel carries the gloss (wings 0, body 0.35, eyes 0.8 in build_insect.py; wet_darken 1 so it only changes the shine), with a faint rim sheen so the wings glint. flutter_pivot is build_insect.py's wing root (*_WING_ROOT_X, *_WING_Y); flutter_split_z its DF_SPLIT_Z (the hind pair lies behind it and beats flutter_hind_lag radians later; the moth's pairs beat together).
